title: Project: Quiz Game
subtitle: Build a real quiz that runs in the terminal. Save the finished code as quiz.py and run it with python quiz.py.

lessons.title: The questions
lessons.buildNote: Your quiz has questions stored as data.

steps.title: Questions as data
steps.body: A quiz is just a **list** of questions, and each question is a **dictionary** with a `question` and an `answer`. Keeping questions as data means you can add more without changing any logic.
steps.code:
questions = [
    {"question": "What is 7 x 8?", "answer": "56"},
    {"question": "What is the capital of Australia?", "answer": "canberra"},
]
print(questions[0]["question"])
